attchmntText: Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kavveri Defence and Wireless Technologies Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations was 243.71 lakhs for the quarter and 287.49 lakhs for the half year. The company reported a profit before tax of 19.34 lakhs for the quarter and a loss before tax of 132.87 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.03 rupees for the quarter and negative 0.22 rupees for the half year. Total assets stood at 14,017.73 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. The board meeting concluded on November 14, 2026.
